prepare.title: Prepare Shipment
prepare.boxUnavailable: We couldn't load the box details
prepare.boxFallbackNote: This product has no assigned box; we'll use the standard box for the label.
prepare.boxWarning: If you use a bigger or very different box than this one, the carrier may charge extra fees and that changes your payout.
prepare.successMsg: The delivery truck knows you're on your way. Print your shipping label and attach it to the package.
prepare.shareLabelMsg: Share your shipping label so others can download it if they don't already have it.
prepare.step1: Download and print the complete guide (3 pages).
prepare.step2: Attach the first page to your box with clear tape around the edges (without covering the code).
prepare.step3: Keep the other two pages and take your package to the Paquete Express branch. Provide the other two pages if requested.

packSteps.title: Choose the box
packSteps.hint: Rigid cardboard, sized to your product. If there is too much empty space it moves and gets hit.

packSteps.title: Protect the product
packSteps.hint: Wrap it in bubble wrap or foam on every side.

packSteps.title: Fill the gaps
packSteps.hint: Paper, foam or packing chips until no free space is left.

packSteps.title: Seal the box
packSteps.hint: Strong tape over every opening. Never thin office tape.

packSteps.title: Attach the label
packSteps.hint: Print it and tape it on top of the box with clear tape, without covering the code.

prepare.packConsequence: Inadequate packaging voids any claim against the carrier.
prepare.whereTitle: Where do I get the materials?
whereItems: Stores such as Home Depot, Office Depot, or Office Max. You can also search online.
prepare.whyTitle: Why we ask for these photos
prepare.whyBullet1: If the buyer claims something else arrived, these photos are your backup.
prepare.whyBullet2: They are what lets us file a claim against the carrier.
prepare.whyBullet3: They do not prove what is inside the box — the buyer's unboxing video does.
prepare.slotProductDesc: We want to see your product sitting inside the box with the padding in place, so it clearly cannot move.
prepare.slotBoxDesc: The whole box, closed, with the up arrows visible.
prepare.slotSealingDesc: The whole box from another angle, with the tape visible.
